mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline by more than 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in real sales (RSAFS) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, RSAFS declines do not lead to negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production of more than 0.5% over the past month signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past month signals strong labor market conditions and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annualized inflation rate above 2.5% as measured by CPIAUCSL signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals a monetary tightening cycle causing economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises in the same month.
